title: Value Proposition Canvas
lead: A visual tool for mapping what an organisation offers against what customers actually need — ensuring strategic fit.

sections.heading: Value Proposition Canvas
sections.caption: The Value Proposition Canvas — aligning the Value Map (product/service side) with the Customer Profile.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The Value Proposition Canvas (VPC), developed by Alex Osterwalder, is a two-sided tool. On the right is the Customer Profile — describing customer jobs, pains and gains. On the left is the Value Map — describing the products/services, pain relievers and gain creators. The goal is to achieve 'fit' between the two sides.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: In ITOM, the Value Proposition Canvas is used to define IT's value proposition to the business. It helps articulate what IT services relieve business pains and create business gains — making the operating model's purpose explicit and customer-centric.

items.desc: Functional, social and emotional tasks the customer needs to accomplish.
Risks, obstacles and frustrations experienced when trying to get the job done.
Benefits, outcomes and aspirations the customer desires.
The offerings that help customers get their jobs done.
How the offering reduces or eliminates customer pains.
How the offering produces customer gains.
